All three tests now pass. I didn't edit the tests. Both bugs were in `textstats/core.py`:

1. **`tokenize`**: the regex `[a-z]+` split words at apostrophes, so "don't" became "don" and "t" and the count came out as 3 instead of 2. It's now `[a-z]+(?:'[a-z]+)*`, which keeps apostrophes inside words.
2. **`top_words`**: the sort key was only `-count`, so ties kept insertion order instead of alphabetical order. It's now `(-count, word)`.

The test-runner agent ran the suite after the fix and reported no failures. Its first run hit its turn limit and returned nothing, so I fixed the bugs from reading the code and relied on the second run to confirm.
